scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with explicit cumulant enumeration, trivariate Gaussian moment reductions and a rational sign bound. Finite enumerations and Monte Carlo are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Regularity and common order/degree are necessary for isolating triangle count from the third moment; irregular graphs admit additional path-count contributions. Equivalent unindexed statistical formulations remain possible. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Third angular-width moments of regular graphical zonotopes recover graph triangles
